summary: Engadget's running roundup of early Black Friday 2023 tech deals at Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy and other retailers, focused on products it has tested. It covers Apple devices, audio gear, smart home products, game consoles and games, TVs, laptops, VPNs and subscriptions, with prices and review context. An FAQ gives the Black Friday and Cyber Monday dates and retailer timing.
one_line: Engadget's curated list of 53 early Black Friday 2023 tech deals across Apple, Sonos, Sony, Google, Amazon, gaming and more, with prices and FAQs.
key_facts: Black Friday 2023 falls on November 24, with Cyber Monday on November 27.
Walmart's Black Friday deals began online November 8, with Walmart+ members getting a few hours of early access; in-store price matching starts November 10.
Apple's 9th-gen iPad dropped to a new low of $230 at Amazon and Target; the 256GB model is $380.
The Apple Watch Series 9 is $329 for the 41mm model and $359 for the 45mm, $70 off, while the Apple Watch SE hit a record low of $179.
Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Gen) are $190 at Amazon, Target and Best Buy, matching an all-time low, and the older Lightning version will be $169 at Walmart on November 22.
The iPad Air M1 is at a record low of $500, and the 10th-gen 64GB iPad is $349, $100 off.
The new 14-inch M3 MacBook Pro with 8GB of memory and 512GB of storage is $1,449, $150 off Apple's list price.
Hulu's deal offers one year of the ad-supported tier for $12, about $1 per month and 85 percent off the standard monthly price.
Sonos's sale runs through November 27, with the Sonos Arc at $719, Beam (Gen 2) at $399 and Era 100 at $199.
The Sony WH-1000XM5 is $328 and the WF-1000XM5 hit a new low of $248.
The Google Pixel 8 Pro is $799 and the Pixel 8 is as low as $549; the Pixel Tablet is an all-time low $399.
The Xbox Series X with Diablo IV is $439 at Walmart, and the PS5 Slim with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III is $499.
The Nintendo Switch OLED bundle costs $350 and includes Super Smash Bros. Ultimate and three months of Nintendo Switch Online.
ProtonVPN offers 30 months at $4 per month, $120 total, and Surfshark's two-year Surfshark One plan is $2.69 per month.
